Quanto custa um design system?: How much does a design system cost?
Um projeto típico, com cerca de 25 compo: A typical project, with about 25 components in Figma and code, comes to around R$ 6.800. Foundation ranges from R$ 3.000 to R$ 4.500; Product system, from R$ 6.000 to R$ 9.000; and the ongoing partnership costs from R$ 2.200 to R$ 3.800 per month.
Design system é só para empresa grande?: Is a design system only for large companies?
Não. Um produto pequeno com uma fundação: No. A small product with a well-built foundation grows without piling up inconsistencies. The Foundation tier exists precisely for those just starting out who want to avoid rework later.
Vocês entregam em código ou só no Figma?: Do you deliver in code or only in Figma?
Os dois são possíveis. A Fundação é entr: Both are possible. Foundation is delivered in Figma; Product system includes the components in code (React and CSS), with the same names and tokens as in Figma.
Dá para criar a partir de um produto que: Can it be built from an existing product?
Sim, e é o caso mais comum. A auditoria: Yes, and that's the most common case. The audit starts from the current screens, keeps what works and consolidates what's duplicated, without requiring the product to be rebuilt from scratch.
Qual a diferença para um guia de marca?: How is it different from a brand guide?
O guia de marca define logotipo, cores e: A brand guide defines the logo, colors and tone of voice. A design system turns that into ready-to-use interface pieces, with states, behavior rules and code.
